slug: 2024-03-28 A Transformative Journey of Mass Birth Registration and Health Insurance in The Gambia

facts.fact: The World Bank says the Interior Ministry's national ID system was integrated with the Health Ministry's civil registration through an eCRVS that generates a unique national identification number at registration.

The World Bank says nearly 1.17 million people were registered and issued a unique national identification number between Aug 2022 and Feb 2023, about 42% of the 2.8 million population (share computed here from the population held).
The World Bank says the eCRVS issued birth certificates each carrying a unique national identification number, generated in real time at registration, during the Aug 2022 to Feb 2023 campaign.

GMB.note: The document does not say who operates or maintains the national ID system.

facts.fact: The World Bank says the eCRVS has become the foundational interoperability system across ministries, using the unique national identification number as the common key.
The World Bank says the Interior Ministry's national ID system was in use, with a unique national identification number issued to nearly 1.17 million people through the eCRVS.
